content.title: Brooklyn Nets at Philadelphia 76ers - Where to Watch, Stream Info, TV Channel, and Live Updates (March 14, 2026)
content.text: The Brooklyn Nets will face off against the Philadelphia 76ers in a matchup that highlights contrasting fortunes for both teams. The Nets enter the game with a record of 17-49, having lost their last two contests. In contrast, the 76ers hold a record of 35-31, although they are currently on a one-game losing streak. Key players for the 76ers include Tyrese Maxey, who leads the team with an average of 29 points per game, while Andre Drummond contributes significantly on the boards with 8.4 rebounds per game. The Nets’ scoring is spearheaded by Michael Porter Jr., averaging 24.2 points per game, but they will be challenged by injuries, including the potential absence of Porter Jr. and Nic Claxton. This game presents an opportunity for both teams to shift momentum as they navigate the latter part of the season.
